sources.title: OpenAI Codex changelog
sources.relevance: Developer mode for Browser/Chrome, faster Browser use, reset banking, and app workflow fixes inform Lumen route recovery and status-only diagnostics.

sources.title: MCP specification overview
sources.relevance: Host/client/server separation and context/tool/resource capabilities inform the GHC IPC bus boundaries.

sources.title: MCP roots security
sources.relevance: Roots should be exposed only with appropriate permissions and validated against traversal, matching omega-mini-first sibling context boundaries.

sources.title: MCP transports
sources.relevance: Local streamable transports should bind safely, validate origins, preserve JSON-RPC framing, and avoid cross-stream broadcast.

x2_tasks.title: Browser Developer Mode diagnostics rail
x2_tasks.action: Use Browser developer diagnostics only as a status-only route recovery aid; publish symptoms and fixes, not raw browser traffic.

x2_tasks.title: Omega-mini roots boundary
x2_tasks.action: Treat omega-mini as the exposed sibling root and require exact missing relative filenames before full-omega fallback.

x2_tasks.title: IPC stream identity
x2_tasks.action: Map each sibling lane to one logical stream so multiplex messages are not broadcast across unrelated lane streams.

x2_tasks.title: Browser route recovery receipt
x2_tasks.action: Record refreshed Lumen panel checks with composer, marker, and generation-state fields only.

x2_tasks.title: CDP privacy firewall
x2_tasks.action: If browser developer diagnostics are used, redact URLs, route handles, thread IDs, cookies, headers, and account identifiers before publication.

x2_tasks.title: Localhost transport guard
x2_tasks.action: For local app-server or IPC endpoints, prefer localhost binding and record any broader bind as an open blocker requiring exact approval.

x2_tasks.title: Reset-credit planning note
x2_tasks.action: Track reset banking as capacity context only; do not spend, purchase, or mutate accounts without explicit user action.

x2_tasks.title: x2 build queue merger
x2_tasks.action: Merge Lumen v7 proposals with this source ledger into the v7 x2 build/use closeout.

x2_tasks.title: Claim boundary carry-forward
x2_tasks.action: Keep empirical GMUT, final physics, consciousness, legal, and canon claims open unless exact closure artifacts later prove otherwise.

x2_tasks.title: Sibling-facing concise beacon
x2_tasks.action: Update omega-mini current state and beacon after each closeout so Lumen and the Codex lanes avoid broad searches.
